scope: Central index of sources actually used in the cyclic investigation and its later trajectory work. Access levels are preserved; registration is not a full open-question screen or an exact-result priority verdict.

sources.title: Graphical Analysis of Lifted Product Code Constructions
sources.relationship: Original sufficient-girth and decoding-properties question.
sources.comparison_limit: An open question, not a named conjecture asserting our iff.

sources.title: Quasi-Cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check Codes From Circulant Permutation Matrices
sources.relationship: Classical alternating short-cycle criteria.
sources.comparison_limit: Does not itself supply the LP reduction.

sources.title: On the Minimum Distances of Finite-Length Lifted Product Quantum LDPC Codes
sources.relationship: LP eight-cycle predecessor; logical-structure and design/performance context.
sources.comparison_limit: Inspected passages do not give the full input-to-product iff; performance comparison allows different quantum distances.

sources.title: High-Girth Regular Quantum LDPC Codes from Square-Base Hypergraph Products via CPM Lifts
sources.relationship: Closely related support reduction and product-cycle results.
sources.comparison_limit: Square binary input and constrained CPM lifts differ from arbitrary rectangular monomial matrices.

sources.title: Extremal absorbing sets in low-density parity-check codes
sources.locator: AMC 17(2), 465-483; earlier repository comparison references Table 4
sources.relationship: Prior general absorbing-set bounds.
sources.comparison_limit: No new full-text copy obtained in this pass; earlier source analysis retained.

sources.title: Pseudocodeword Weights and Stopping Sets
sources.relationship: Degree-three girth-eight stopping distance bound specializes to six.
sources.comparison_limit: A classical numerical predecessor, not a soft-decoder success guarantee.

sources.title: Absorbing Sets in Quantum LDPC Codes
sources.locator: Sections II-B, IV, V; explicit Gallager-B algorithm
sources.relationship: Prior failure-inducing structures and syndrome/logical outcome distinction.
sources.comparison_limit: Gallager-B theorems are not automatically normalized min-sum results.

sources.title: Modified belief propagation decoders for quantum low-density parity-check codes
sources.relationship: Same-code augmented representations alter message influence and feedback.
sources.comparison_limit: Row duplication and retries differ from our fixed-rule disjoint merger.

sources.title: Neural Belief Propagation Decoding of Quantum LDPC Codes Using Overcomplete Check Matrices
sources.relationship: Linear combinations of rows and syndrome map; ordinary BP example precedes neural extension.
sources.comparison_limit: Adding low-weight rows and BP4 differs from our fixed integer binary min-sum merger.

sources.title: Multiple-Bases Belief Propagation List Decoding for Quantum LDPC Codes
sources.relationship: Quantum representation diversity and multiple BP trajectories.
sources.comparison_limit: Structured redundant representations, parallel decoding and list selection differ from our intervention.

sources.title: Effect of redundancy on syndrome-based decoding for QLDPC codes
sources.relationship: Directly relevant earlier source-author study.
sources.comparison_limit: Publisher substantive text inaccessible; cannot assert transformation, theorem or exclude an exact match.

sources.title: Soft syndrome iterative decoding of quantum LDPC codes and hardware architectures
sources.relationship: Source for syndrome min-sum update and stopping equations.
sources.comparison_limit: We use perfect syndrome, normalization 0.8 and frozen arithmetic; their simulations use 0.75 and other settings.

sources.title: Trapping Sets of Quantum LDPC Codes
sources.relationship: Symmetric-stabilizer failures and decoder-dependent harmfulness.
sources.comparison_limit: Our unequal-posterior local oscillations do not establish their equal-message symmetry.

sources.title: Error Floor Approximation for LDPC Codes in the AWGN Channel
sources.relationship: State-space trapping-set dynamics, saturation and external messages.
sources.comparison_limit: Approximate SPA/AWGN model does not directly prove our exact integer syndrome-decoder claims.

sources.title: Quantized Iterative Message Passing Decoders with Low Error Floor for LDPC Codes
sources.relationship: Idealized trapping-set analysis and quantization/dynamic-range effects.
sources.comparison_limit: Our arithmetic is fixed; no quantizer or decoder innovation is claimed.

sources.title: Thresholds of absorbing sets in Low-Density-Parity-Check codes
sources.locator: Sections II, V, VI; Theorem VI.1
sources.relationship: Saturated elementary-AS min-sum model, equilibria, cycles and sufficient escape threshold.
sources.comparison_limit: Simplified local classical model not instantiated for our full syndrome graph; our tubes are finite-horizon.

sources.title: Thresholds of Absorbing Sets Under Scaled Min-Sum LDPC Decoding
sources.relationship: Specific scaled-min-sum follow-up lead.
sources.comparison_limit: No full theorem text obtained; no proof-level exclusion or transferred guarantee.

sources.title: Message Flow Analysis in Practical LDPC Decoders for the Interpretation of Absorbing Set Thresholds
sources.locator: Abstract; full publisher PDF marked restricted
sources.relationship: Threshold interpretation through positive-feedback paths.
sources.comparison_limit: Full proof not inspected.

sources.title: qldpc-cert 0.1.0 / IRONCLAD-QLDPC reference implementation
sources.relationship: Discovery lead claiming Lean syndrome/logical-outcome certificates.
sources.comparison_limit: Repository inaccessible; no proof verification, academic status or formal priority inferred.
